tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch2:2-8↗ ex:open-mobius-band Prove that the action of $\mathbb {Z}$ on $\mathbb {R}^2$ defined in Example 2.35 is smooth, free, proper, and isometric, and therefore the open Möbius band inherits a flat Riemannian metric such that the quotient map is a Riemannian covering. \end{exercise}
